dataList.content: L'Inamovible will enter и leave the Смена комнаты in intervals.
Attacking L'Inamovible while she is in the Смена комнаты will increase her aggressiveness.

Sous Chef gains "Расфосованные чурки" from units she kills. These are consumed при the end of the turn, granting her стаков of "Кушай и слушай".

The more she gets the стаков, the stronger и more frequent will her powerful move, "Вырежи на мне своё имя", become.
Leather Wallets are not an exception когда it comes to Sous Chef's ingredient-gathering. You cannot stop her culinary activity на playing defensively.

Когда Sous Chef fails to kill any targets, she will get стаков of "Аппетит". При 3 стака, she will use another powerful Skill. It may be a good idea to let her continue cooking every один раз in a while.
Sometimes, Clashing against the Floor Manager's certain skill with your Attack Skills could be a bad idea.

Be too wary и let yourself accumulate 10 стаков of "Новый слой жира", и you will risk inviting the Floor Manager's powerful Skill.
Pay attention so that "Новый слой жира" не reach 10 стаков. You may also choose to теряет a Clash against a certain Skill to remove the стаков.
Если you have "Спасибо за обед!", perhaps you will want to stay your attacks for a short while.
The Crimson God [Ошибка юности]'s Lifecord houses immense power. It may be a good idea to prioritize destroying it before все else.
Let a Sinner with high ХП наносит with the Crimson God [Ошибка юности]'s powerful Skill.

Если your units are gaining too many "Baptism [Crimson]" стаков, использует Defense Skills to remove them. При макс. стаков, it causes a great наносит of Bleed Damage, и the defeated unit will become an enemy—"Ripped Flesh of the Crimson God [Ошибка юности]."

Если you are hit на the "Pick stitch too obvious, you say?! I'll pick-stitch your ass!" Skill while you have accumulated many стаков of Naildle, you will enter the "Taxidermized" state и receive devastating урона.
Если there are surviving Needlekins in the same turn as когда the King of Needleworks uses a powerful Skill, they will enhance that Skill's урона.
